Alex — attaching the redacted pen test summary we can share publicly and the vuln process workbook you asked for. Note: full detailed findings are available under NDA; we've shared redacted summaries with multiple customers.

Attachments: Redwood_PenTest_Report_2026-10.pdf (redacted summary), Redwood_Vuln_Process_SLA.xlsx

High-level vuln management highlights:
- Remediation SLAs (target): Critical: 7 days; High: 30 days; Medium: 90 days; Low: tracked for next release.
- Scanning cadence: External auth/blackbox scans monthly; internal authenticated scans weekly for core infra; dependency SCA (software composition analysis) nightly.
- Disclosure policy: coordinated disclosure; customers are notified for customer-impacting findings.
- Tracking & retest: We create a remediation ticket in our tracker (Jira) and run a retest within SLA windows; we maintain a public status of remediations for customers under contract.

We also have a sponsored pentest program (we engage 3rd party firms) — I've cc'd SecOps Pentest Labs as the vendor on this thread so they can confirm timelines and retest options.

Hi Alex — quick technical follow-up from our security team: 

- CVSS thresholds: we classify Critical >= 9.0, High 7.0-8.9, Medium 4.0-6.9. Critical items trigger immediate mitigation planning and hotfix prioritization.
- Root cause & mitigation notes are included in each remediation ticket.
- Retest window: for Critical/High we aim for verification within 72 hours after a patch is deployed; for Medium within 14 days post-remediation.
- Disclosure: coordinated disclosure only; we do not publicly disclose exploitable details before customers are protected.
- Integration: we can provide a read-only Jira project/board for FinHealth if you want visibility into remediation tickets; alternatively we provide exportable weekly reports.

If you'd like, I can share an example remediation ticket export and the retest checklist prior to the call.

Cheers,
